$ fastexec help
exit: 1
--- stdout
Comando desconhecido: 'help'
Comandos disponíveis: mcp, exec, get, put, sql, job, ping, stats, handoff, firestick, daemon
--- stderr


$ fastexec frobnicate
exit: 1
--- stdout
Comando desconhecido: 'frobnicate'
Comandos disponíveis: mcp, exec, get, put, sql, job, ping, stats, handoff, firestick, daemon
--- stderr


$ fastexec exec
exit: 1
--- stdout
Uso: fastexec exec [host] <comando>
--- stderr


$ fastexec get
exit: 1
--- stdout
Uso: fastexec get <remote_path> [local_path] [host]
--- stderr


$ fastexec put local.txt
exit: 1
--- stdout
Uso: fastexec put <local_path> <remote_path> [host]
--- stderr


$ fastexec sql
exit: 1
--- stdout
Uso: fastexec sql "<query>" [session_ou_db] [host]
--- stderr


$ fastexec job start
exit: 1
--- stdout
Uso: fastexec job start "<comando>" [job_id] [host]
--- stderr


$ fastexec daemon foo
exit: 0
--- stdout
Uso: fastexec daemon <status|start|stop>
--- stderr
